title: Signature Replay Vulnerability via Unprotected Nonce Verification Bounds in `setAuthorizationWithSig`
impact: While nonces are strictly incremented per authorizer (`authorization.nonce == nonce[authorization.authorizer]++`), a signature can be captured and broadcasted anytime before `authorization.deadline`. If an authorizer signs a transaction granting broad permissions (`isAuthorized = true`), malicious actors observing the mempool could front-run or delay execution within the validity window, causing unexpected authorization state updates at inconvenient timestamps.
